video_title: Jaylen Brown to Trailblazers??? Bobby Marks on BIGGEST Offseason Moves in NBA

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston had the best player in the Giannis trade deal
quotes.excerpt: Boston had the best player in the deal, Jaylen Brown is a top-10, top-5 player
quotes.quote: Boston had the best player in the deal, Jaylen Brown is a top-10, top-5 player in here and there were some future picks coming. The Miami package is a little bit of everything where you are looking at turning to Neda meant last night, 13th pick and then the future picks and young players and Tyler Herro here. It gives you a little bit more of a way to rip the band-aid off and basically start at ground zero here as far as how to rebuild that roster.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Concerns regarding Jaylen Brown's fit in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: How does Jaylen Brown fit with Khris Middleton and Miles Turner?
quotes.quote: If you are Milwaukee, I think somewhat of the concern is Jaylen Brown is a heck of a player, but how does Jaylen Brown fit with Khris Middleton and Miles Turner and what happens two years from now if Jaylen Brown doesn't want to be here? We are going through the whole Giannis situation all over again here. I was leaning a little bit towards the Miami package just from a rebuilding standpoint because there are a little bit more flexibility with that group.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat face roster challenges after Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: They are going to lose Norm Powell in free agency because of the trade
quotes.quote: They are going to lose Norm Powell in free agency because of the trade and because they took a lot of more money back and some of the restrictions that come with it. So you basically have five roster spots to give to players on the veteran minimum exception. You need some shooting, you need a little bit more depth in your front court here. It is a matter of what players are willing to take a little bit of a discount to go down to South Florida.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland Trail Blazers as a wild card in trade market
quotes.excerpt: Whenever you have a first-year owner, they are like the biggest wild card in this
quotes.quote: Portland put both feet in the deep end when it came to Giannis and was a team that was interested in trading for him. I always say, and I have gone through four ownership changes when I was in New Jersey and Brooklyn, whenever you have a first-year owner, they are like the biggest wild card in this because they are learning the rules. They tried to trade for him and I think the concern with Giannis was certainly extending there if he would commit long-term.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves need to utilize trade exception
quotes.excerpt: You move off the Julius Randle contract, you resign Ayo Dosunmu, you have got this big trade exception
quotes.quote: You move off the Julius Randle contract, you resign Ayo Dosunmu, you have got this big trade exception. Some people can argue they are worthless and I said wait a minute, Bobby Portis got traded to Miami and it went into a trade exception. So there is a little value there. So I think what is the next move? You have got some spending power to go out and do that. If you told me that is it and they are just going to fill out the roster with some minimum contracts, I would say that is a major concern.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's future and Clippers roster changes
quotes.excerpt: I am interested what happens with Kawhi Leonard
quotes.quote: I am interested what happens with Kawhi Leonard. I think that is the name I would pay attention to. With the Clippers, they have gone from an older, more veteran team to they flipped James Harden for Darius Garland, they got younger, they drafted Kobe Bufkin. Kawhi is going into the last year of his contract, he is extension eligible. I think the big question is how does he fit long-term into their plans.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.excerpt: I think they could lose Mitch Robinson, I think they can lose Julius Randle
quotes.quote: They are going to be interesting about I think they could lose Mitch Robinson, I think they can lose Julius Randle, we will see what happens with Jose Alvarado and a team that is coming off the championship now is basically going to have to replenish some of the depth that was really good for them.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' contract will dictate Lakers' offseason moves
quotes.excerpt: I think what LeBron James signs for will dictate can you go and get a center
quotes.quote: LeBron James plays a big role from a spending power as far as how much you have. I think what LeBron James signs for will dictate can you go and get a center in free agency. I don't think you can, an A-list center, or do you go out in a trade? You have got some of your future picks. Austin is an interesting process to go through because he is going to opt out of this player option, he is unrestricted. The market is not great, just a lot of teams that have spending power.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Restricted free agents to watch this summer
quotes.excerpt: You are looking at Jalen Duren in Detroit, Walker Kessler in Utah, Tari Eason in Houston
quotes.quote: You are looking at Jalen Duren in Detroit, Walker Kessler in Utah, who came off a year that he didn't, I think he missed most of the year. Tari Eason in Houston, Trey goes back to Washington on a huge number. Harden has got a player option, I think that is the one to watch as far as what his contract is going to be to come back at a lower number here.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The sense of arrogance in front office decision-making
quotes.excerpt: You have a sense of arrogance. And there is sometimes a good arrogance and there is a bad arrogance
quotes.quote: When you are in a front office, you have a sense of arrogance. And there is sometimes a good arrogance and there is a bad arrogance, but there is a sense of arrogance that every move you make there is going to be a positive outcome. And whether the consequences aren't there and I think you saw the certainly I live through the consequences of the, you always think you are going to be good. I think that is the biggest thing. You always think the roster you put together is going to be good.
